0022600145.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Sacramento Kings with both teams still winless: the Pelicans are 0-3 on a three-game losing streak and sit 14th in the West, while the Kings are 0-4 on a four-game skid and sit 15th. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and their last meeting was a 117-113 loss to the Kings in Sacramento on April 3, 2026.
